description: This file defines the ResourceMonitor class and related types for monitoring resources within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes interface definitions, a templated resource monitor class with platform-specific worker implementations, and singleton access to the resource monitor instance.

classes.name: IResource
classes.description: Interface for resources to be monitored, providing methods for descriptor retrieval, event notification, and handling.

classes.name: ResourceMonitorType
classes.description: Templated class managing resource monitoring, platform-specific worker implementation, resource registration, and event handling.

classes.name: ResourceMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to the resource monitor instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceMonitor.
